items.title: He Earned Too Much for Social Security Before His Layoff. This Little-Known Rule Could Still Unlock $16,800.
items.summary: Most workers laid off midyear assume a big salary already disqualifies them from Social Security, and that assumption quietly costs some of them months of benefits they were fully entitled to collect.

items.title: SWK Q2 Deep Dive: Productivity Gains and Brand Strength Drive Margin Expansion
items.summary: Manufacturing company Stanley Black & Decker (NYSE:SWK) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, but sales were flat year on year at $3.96 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.57 per share was 29.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
